text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.title: Simple Visuals
text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.option.par:
Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: SUBTLE.
text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.option.vis: Player Locator

Player heads for Vanilla waypoints; server
visibility and bar priority remain. Default:
true.
Chat Heads

Displays the player's head next to their chat
messages. Default: true.
Status Effect Bars

Shows a duration bar under status effect
icons. Default: true.
Elytra Pitch Helper

Shows guide lines for perfect pitch while
gliding. Default: true.
Target Angle Up

Optimal upward pitch angle for Elytra flight.
Default: -40.0.
Target Angle Down

Optimal downward pitch angle for Elytra
flight. Default: 40.0.
Pitch Tolerance

Acceptable deviation from target angles for
optimal Elytra flight. Default: 10.0.
Guide Sensitivity

Responsiveness of the pitch guide lines.
Default: 4.0.
Renamed item model compatibility

Compatibility; automatically disabled with
Simple Models. Enables custom textures for
renamed items based on the files in the
config folder. §cRequires a game restart to
take effect! Default: false.
Enable Anvil Formatting codes

The server policy decides; Vanilla costs
remain. Allows using '&' as a formatting code
in anvils (e.g., &c for red, &k for magic).
Default: true.
Enhance own death messages

Appends coordinates [x, y, z] to chat death
messages if the player is in render distance.
Default: true.
Own death coordinates

Only your own death coordinates, entirely
local. Default: SEPARATE.
Map Tooltips

Shows coordinates and biome info when
hovering over maps in the inventory. Default:
true.

Enable Speed Lines

Displays speed lines when moving fast with
elytra. Default: true.
Speed Lines Color (Hex)

Color of the speed lines in hexadecimal
format (e.g., #FF0000 for red). Default:
16777215.
Speed Lines Transparency

Transparency of the speed lines (0 = fully
transparent, 255 = fully opaque). Default:
0.7.
Speed Lines Amount

Number of speed lines to display. Default:
1.0.
Speed Lines Tunnel Radius

Radius of the speed lines tunnel effect.
Default: 0.7.
Speed Lines Width
Width of each speed line. Default: 8.0.
Speed Lines Animation Speed

Speed of the speed lines animation. Default:
1.0.
Speed Lines Length
Length of the speed lines. Default: 4.0.
Speed Lines Speed Threshold

Minimum speed required to display speed
lines. Default: 0.6.
Enable Held Item Tooltips

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Show Durability

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Show Enchantments

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Max Enchantments to Show

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 3.
Enable Pickup Notifier

Displays a notifier on screen when picking up
items or XP. Default: true.
Offset X

Horizontal offset of the pickup notifier on
the screen. Default: 10.
Offset Y

Vertical offset of the pickup notifier on the
screen. Default: 10.
Scale

Scale of the pickup notifier display.
Default: 1.0.
Display Duration

Duration (in seconds) the pickup notifier
remains visible. Default: 120.
Show XP

If enabled, the pickup notifier will also
display XP pickups. Default: true.
Screen Side

Side of the screen where the pickup notifier
appears (Left or Right). Default: RIGHT.
Content Layout

Layout of the pickup notifier content
(Horizontal or Vertical). Default:
COUNT_ICON_NAME.
Show item icon

Displays the item icon in the pickup
notifier. Default: true.
Show item name

Displays the item name in the pickup
notifier. Default: true.
Show item count

Displays the item count in the pickup
notifier. Default: true.
Use rarity color

Colors the item name based on its rarity.
Default: true.
Vanilla background style

Uses the vanilla Minecraft style for the
pickup notifier. Default: true.
Background Opacity

Opacity of the pickup notifier background
(0.0 - 1.0). Default: 1.0.
